positive_control.rule: mean PD > 0 AND CI_lo(mean T_RB natural) > 0 AND CI_lo(mean[T_nat - T_same_year]) > 0

notes: Bonferroni within the secondary family {S1,S2} only; no global FWER including P1.
Bootstrap intervals are nominal, approximate and conditional on fitted bases/moments and the 2 frames of this split.
The positive gate does not guarantee against weak-signal splits.
If the test-split orig RB scale approaches epsilon, passing S2 is not strong mechanism preservation.

P1.reading: lhs=gauss; a positive or undistinguished difference does not support Gaussian superiority
